Chapter 6608: Time Stopper

Chapter 6608: Time Stopper

“What can make it stop, Dao Brother?” Grand Preceptor asked.

Sixth-sense said: “Senior Li Xingchen had a supreme treasure. Its movement could stop anything, including this maelstrom.”

“Time Stopper.” Godstallion knew of it.

“That’s it.” Sixth-sense nodded.

Listeners exchanged glances upon hearing this.

“Is it real?” A desolate god asked.

“I’ve heard of it but never saw it.” An emperor said.

“Li Xingchen possessed it, capable of stopping time, even reversing or fast-forwarding on a large scale.” A heaven-slayer whispered.

“The overlords’ abilities.” Primal ancestors and heaven-slayers didn’t quite grasp time, let alone control it. More often than not, they were victims when trying to pry further into this dao.

Overlords, on the other hand, could reach this level. Of course, mastery depended on the individual.

“Not all overlords can do this, Li Xingchen’s dao is peerless and different from ours. His temporal dao couldn’t be cultivated.” An older primal ancestor said.

Li Xingchen’s dao remained a mystery. However, it was different from ancient progenitors or modern primal ancestors. Rumor has it he created his own path.

“Where is this treasure right now?” Godstallion asked.

Sixth-sense smiled and pointed at the stars: “If Senior Li Xingchen is undergoing a rebirth, he is this ocean of stars. Therefore, Time Stopper must be hidden within one of them. As long as we find it, the spring will be up for grabs.”

“Are you sure?” Grand Preceptor glanced at the stars.

“If the rebirth is true, then yes. However, it’s a matter of luck and virtue for the first to find Time Stopper.” Sixth-sense said.

“I agree.” Others immediately joined in.

“Why don’t we start an agreement? Time Stopper will belong to whoever finds it first.” An emperor proposed.

“I believe that is fair.” Other desolate gods joined in.

However, primal ancestors didn’t say anything. This agreement certainly benefited weaker cultivators. Of course, the agreement itself was as feeble as a piece of paper. The strongest cultivators here decided whether it was valid or not.

“Don’t worry about this, let’s start the search first.” Someone suggested after seeing the silent primal ancestors and heaven-slayers.

“I will test my luck then.” Grand Preceptor laughed and returned to the area, crossing through space using his portal from one star to another.

“Me too.” Godstallion was even faster, traveling across half of this star ocean in the blink of an eye.

“Go, don’t miss it!” Others hurriedly began the search. A few of them thought they could try hiding it or selling it at a high price.

This was much harder than finding a needle in the ocean due to the vastness of space. Only emperors and up had a chance due to their speed. Weaker cultivators couldn’t even see their movement.

For example, Godstallion only appeared for a split second before going to the next star. The strongest ancient ancestors could only see silhouettes.

The participants didn’t hold back, utilizing their speed and divine intent to the limit in their search for Time Stopper.

When they activated their most formidable abilities, their auras flooded the entire star ocean. The overflowing powers still spilled forth and reached Heaven World.

Living beings couldn’t handle the influx of power and trembled in fear. The destructive capability was enough to reduce Heaven World to ashes.

“Pop!” Suddenly, a ripple attracted everyone’s attention.
